SfRuzva gadato mama ॥ yAvanti cAkzarARyeva gIyamAne yaSAsvini ! । tAvadbarzasahasrARi indraloke mahIyate ॥ rUpavAn guRavAn sidDaH sarvvavedavidAM varaH । nityaM paSyati vE vajrapARiM devaM na saMSayaH ॥ madBaktaScEva jAyeta indralokapaTe sTitaH । sarvvakarmmaguRaSrezWastatrApi mama pUjakaH ॥ indralokAt pariBrazwo mama gItaparAyaRaH । pramuktaH sarvvasaMsArAnmama lokAya gacCati ॥ yastu gAyati suSroRi ! kOmudyAYcEva dbAdaSIm । sarvvasaNgaM parityajya mama lokAya gacCati ॥ yastu gAyati gItAni mama jAgaraRe sadA । sarvvasaNgAt pramukto vE mama lokAya gacCati ॥ etatte kaTitaM devi ! gAyanasya PalaM mahat । yasya gItasya Sabdena taret saMsArasAgaram ॥ * ॥ vAditrasya pravakzyAmi tat SfRuzva vasunDare ! । prAptavAnmanujo yena deveByaH samatAM svayam ॥ sampatkAlaprayogeRa sannipAtena vA punaH । navavarzasahasrARi navavarzaSatAni ca ॥ kuveraBavanaM gatvA modate vE yadfcCayA । kuveraBavanAdBrazwaH svacCandagamanAlayaH ॥ SayyAditAlasampAtErmama lokAya gacCati ॥ * ॥ nftyamAnasya vakzyAmi tacCfRuzva vasunDare ! । manujA yena gacCanti CittvA saMsArasAgaram ॥ triMSadvarzasahasrARi triMSadbarzaSatAni ca । puzkaradvIpamAsAdya svacCandagamanAlayaH ॥ PalaM prApnoti suSroRi ! mama karmmaparAyaRaH । rUpavAn guRavAn SUraH SIlavAn supaTe sTitaH ॥ madBaktaScEva jAyeta saMsAraparimocitaH ॥ * ॥ yastu jAgarato nityaM gItavAdyena narttakaH । jambudvIpaM samAsAdya rAjarAjastu jAyate ॥ sarvvakarmmasamAyukto rakzitA vE mahIpatiH । madBaktaScEva jAyeta mama karmmaparAyaRaH ॥” iti varAhapurARam ॥
